description: Manages system-wide permissions, roles, and access control for users and entities within the application.

endpoints.name: GetSystemPermissionConfiguration
endpoints.description: Retrieves the entire system permission configuration, including all roles and their capabilities. This data is primarily used for frontend initialization.
example_uses: How do I get the full list of system permissions?
Show me the complete permission configuration for the application.
I need to initialize the frontend with all available roles and their capabilities.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to fetch the comprehensive, system-wide permission structure, typically at application startup or for administrative overview.

endpoints.name: CheckUserRoutePermission
endpoints.description: Checks if the current authenticated user has permission to access a specific route or page. Returns permission details including access status and specific permissions for the route.

route.description: The route/URL path to check permissions for (e.g., '/partnerships/contacts/123')

example_uses: Can the current user access the '/admin/settings' page?
Check if I have permission for the route '/partnerships/contacts/123'.
What are the permissions for the current user on the '/reports' section?
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to dynamically verify if the currently logged-in user has the necessary permissions to view or interact with a specific application route or page.

endpoints.name: GetEntityPermissionDetails
endpoints.description: Retrieves complete permission details for a specific entity (e.g., 'Contact', 'Partner', 'Interaction'), including all possible operations and role requirements. Returns comprehensive entity permission configuration.
example_uses: What are the permissions associated with the 'Contact' entity?
Show me all possible operations and roles for the 'Partner' entity.
I need the permission configuration for the 'Interaction' entity.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to understand the granular permissions and role requirements for specific business entities within the system.

endpoints.name: GetCurrentUserRoles
endpoints.description: Retrieves the current authenticated user's roles and basic permission assignments. Returns the current user's role assignments and basic information.
example_uses: What roles does the current user have?
List the roles assigned to me.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to quickly get the roles and basic permissions of the user currently making the request.

endpoints.name: GetUserRolesByUserId
endpoints.description: Retrieves roles and basic information for a specific user by their ID. This endpoint typically requires administrative access. Returns the specified user's role assignments and basic information.

userId.description: The ID of the user to retrieve role information for

example_uses: Get the roles for user with ID 'user123'.
Show me the permissions for user 'abc-456'.
I need to see the role assignments for a specific user.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint (with appropriate administrative privileges) to look up the roles and basic permissions of any user by their unique ID.

endpoints.name: GetAvailableSystemRoles
endpoints.description: Retrieves all available system roles and their descriptions. Returns a list of all system roles with metadata.
example_uses: List all roles available in the system.
What are the different types of roles I can assign?
Show me the descriptions for all system roles.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to get a comprehensive list of all predefined roles within the system, useful for role management interfaces or understanding system capabilities.
